author_controls.scope: Source review only this increment; no new executed controls.

source_only_findings: ExportToOracleDb catches initial create-table HIHOException and continues job submission; executes alter-location step even after waitForCompletion false or caught exception. No Oracle/Hadoop execution in this increment.
waitForCompletion exception leaves initial ret=0; alter-location HIHOException also does not affect ret. Source-only, not a newly observed failed job.
getAlterTableDML uses every listStatus entry basename, without isDir filtering or escaping apostrophes; empty nonnull listing emits LOCATION (). Existing original test only uses two ordinary names.

getTableName tokenizes only parentheses and ASCII spaces and overwrites match for each TABLE token; getExternalDir splits only ASCII spaces. No general SQL parser or quoted-identifier contract established.
runQuery calls executeQuery for supplied DML and closes statement/connection only on normal path; exceptions bypass explicit closes. Real Oracle JDBC behavior unqualified.
